name: Feytech Holdings Berhad
overview: 2026年，Feytech 与 Zhejiang Libang Hexin Intelligent Brake System 及 Wuhu Sterling Steering System 签署谅解备忘录，拟成立合资公司生产汽车底盘部件（转向与制动系统），主要供应 Chery 的马来西亚本地化项目；同时，子公司 FT Assembly 与 Evolvelectric Motors 签订装配协议，属经常性关联交易。
overview_en: In 2026, Feytech signed a Memorandum of Understanding with Zhejiang Libang Hexin Intelligent Brake System and Wuhu Sterling Steering System to establish a joint venture for manufacturing automotive chassis components (steering and brake systems), mainly to supply Chery's Malaysia localization project; meanwhile, its subsidiary FT Assembly entered into an assembly agreement with Evolvelectric Motors, a recurrent related party transaction.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年集团层面签署谅解备忘录，拟通过合资进入汽车底盘部件制造，并有一项子公司装配协议。
segments.note_en: At the group level, a Memorandum of Understanding was signed this year to enter automotive chassis component manufacturing via a joint venture, and a subsidiary assembly agreement was entered into.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 与 Zhejiang Libang Hexin Intelligent Brake System 及 Wuhu Sterling Steering System 签署谅解备忘录，拟成立合资公司生产汽车底盘部件（含转向与制动系统），主要供应 Chery 的马来西亚本地化项目。
actions.text_en: Signed a Memorandum of Understanding with Zhejiang Libang Hexin Intelligent Brake System and Wuhu Sterling Steering System to establish a joint venture to manufacture automotive chassis components (including steering and brake systems), mainly to supply Chery'…

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RECURRENT RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 子公司 FT Assembly Sdn. Bhd. 与 Evolvelectric Motors Sdn. Bhd. 签订日期为2026年9月28日的装配协议，属经常性关联交易，估计交易总值达100万令吉或以上。
actions.text_en: Subsidiary FT Assembly Sdn. Bhd. entered into an assembly agreement dated 28 September 2026 with Evolvelectric Motors Sdn. Bhd., a recurrent related party transaction with estimated aggregate value of RM1 million or more.

model_changes.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
model_changes.text: 拟通过合资公司新增汽车底盘部件（转向与制动系统）制造业务，主要供应 Chery 的马来西亚本地化项目。
model_changes.text_en: Proposed to add manufacturing of automotive chassis components (steering and brake systems) through a joint venture, mainly to supply Chery's Malaysia localization project.
